title: Construction Spending — Value of Construction Put in Place (October 2026 data), 10:00 a.m. ET
source: CENSUS: two independent census.gov primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06. (1) economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, 178 rows parsed), row "Construction Spending (Construction Put in Place) | December 1, 2026 | 10:00 AM | October 2026", release code A202612011000, reference A202610. (2) construction/c30/release.html (HTTP 200, 48,117 bytes), the C30 program's own release-schedule table, whose final row reads "October | December 1 | 10:00 a.m." — the same shape of program-owned second primary the m3-full-report-2026-12-03 lane used. Corroborated (not a Census source) by the Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet, whose 2026-12-01 10:00 row reads "Construction spending, ISM Manufacturing Index". Promoted from the m3-full-report-2026-12-03 lane's `estimate` proposal by this event's own initial research: the no-self-confirm convention binds the discovering sweep, not the independent second look, and no Construction Spending row has ever been suspended — 84 consecutive reference months (2019-11 through 2026-10) with zero gaps across seven Census calendars, while the suspensions on those same pages belong to the Advance Economic Indicators Report (5), Preliminary Steel Imports (5) and the Advance Services Report (1). Checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED by the m3-full-report-2026-12-03 adjacency sweep on the argument that this is a GDPNow *trigger* release absent from the calendar while its "other release" proposer was tracked. Initial research 2026-09-06 confirms the trigger claim and then narrows what it is worth. Atlanta Fed GDPNow ContribArchives (1,871 vintages, 1,822 same-quarter deltas): vintages naming construction spending alone (n=9) move |d structures| 0.0438pp against a 0.0006pp baseline (permutation p<0.0001, a 73x ratio) and |d residential| 0.0632pp vs 0.0060pp (p=0.0046) — but |d GDP| 0.0977pp vs 0.0833pp (p=0.77), so the print reallocates inside the structures line without reaching the headline. All 14 of 2026's editions drew a posted update, against 2 of 13 for M3-2. The market-side claim is NOT separable and is not made: 72 of 81 release dates are the first trading day of the month, shared with ISM Manufacturing, and the only 5 off-cycle sessions since 2021 are the post-lapse catch-up window. Census flags the headline m/m as not statistically distinguishable from zero in 27 of 29 measured editions, and the one-month-later revision to the level runs a median 0.74% against a median first-print move of 0.30% — larger than the signal in 14 of 19 pairs. Impact LOW, symbols empty: the footprint is on a model, not a price, and no house playbook is macro-keyed (0 hits, re-grepped 2026-09-06).
